proposal.reason: Main change is in network: NET send-credit TX head storage now defaults to sender-local device memory with new mapping/open/close lifecycle and initialization in src/transport/net.cc. Include transport because src/transport/p2p.cc adds allocation-only proxy P2P buffer setup/teardown and ownership plumbing used by NET connect. Include memory because src/include/alloc.h introduces MEM_LEGACY allocation/free behavior and tracking semantics that affect how these device buffers are allocated and released.
